integrity_notes: The embedded standard-library verifier reproduces exact cyclotomic determinants, spectrum, matrix-tree order and all local Smith valuations. No outside audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the graph on 48 lines of the fixed complex quartic model, not Picard torsion, its Neron-Severi discriminant group, or arbitrary quartic K3 models.
Completeness of the 48-line list is taken from the cited classical source; finite incidence and Smith computations are reconstructed in verify.py.
An equivalent unindexed prior calculation is a residual historical-priority risk.
title: Critical group of the 48-line intersection graph on the complex Fermat quartic
